answer: Every claim climbs the cipher of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sable re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the vertex of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
